Title: Duct
Description: A protective and hollow pipe or conduit used to house, organise and shield fibre optic cables from environmental hazards and mechanical damage. For example, a rigid PVC-U outer protective duct, a multi-way air-blown fibre duct, or a multi-apeture microduct bundle.

Title: None
Description: The transmission medium is directly buried in the ground.

Title: Pipe
Description: A tube used to convey water, gas, oil, or other fluid substances.

Title: Pole
Description: A support commonly used to carry aerial fibre optic cables or for joint use with electrical power cables in distribution/middle-mile networks.
Source: Adapted from the [ITU-T recommendation ITU-T L.330 (10/2020)](https://www.itu.int/myworkspace/rec-external/item?id=14515) definition

Title: Pylon
Description: A tall tower-like structure used for carrying electricity cables high above the ground in transmission/backbone networks. Also known as a transmission tower.
Source: Adapted from the Oxford English Dictionary definition
